description: Installs a newer release of this add-on over the running one

functions.name: installFromUrl
functions.description: Downloads the add-on package at the URL and installs it as an update of this add-on. Resolves once Firefox has installed it, after which the add-on restarts

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A release asset of this add-on on GitHub

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The version the package must contain
